description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for handling nl80211 attributes in a Linux wireless driver context. It includes definitions for attribute initialization, cleanup, and list management, as well as macros for creating and manipulating attributes and a handler prototype for netlink message processing.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_cleanNlAttr
methods.description: Recursively cleans a nl80211 attribute structure and its nested attributes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_initNlAttrList
methods.description: Initializes a list of nl80211 attributes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_cleanNlAttrList
methods.description: Cleans a list of nl80211 attributes.
